Only unasserted Error.stack on the intentional synthetic thrown fetch error
boundaries: Five unchanged original callbacks, helper functions, loops, mutations and assertions execute after static import replacement; actual original Router performs every classification/cache/retry/route.
Response observer returns identical built-in finite Response instances without clone/tee/read or replacing their consumption behavior.
All per-instance request/result sequences and complete raw/parsed request bodies, headers, response status/text and deliberate fetch rejection are retained.
The finite response recorder allows the original 1,048,625-byte oversized metadata JSON; production metadata stays limited to 1 MiB and decisions to 64 KiB.
No timed/cancellation/stream schedule, real service, model/download, provider/platform or numerical performance qualification.
